# ud-tools (D-sorganization/Tools)

> Engineering calculators, process models, and agent-facing MCP surfaces.

## Agent API (MCP)

- MCP entry: `.mcp.json` registers `ud-tools-mcp` (stdio calculator server).
- Console script: `ud-tools-mcp` (optional install: `pip install '.[calc-mcp]'`).
- Operator guide: `AGENTS.md` section "Agent API (engineering calculators over MCP)".

## Catalog and schemas

- Tool catalog: `tools.json` (generated from `src/**/gui_registration.py`).
- Cross-repo surface contract: `tool_surface_contract.json` (`surfaces.mcp` marks calculator tools).
- Calculator REST OpenAPI: run `uvicorn calc_backend.app:app` and open `/openapi.json`.
- CalculatorSpec registry: `src/shared/python/calc_backend/registry/`.

## Design manual formula IDs

- Governance: `config/design_manual_governance.json`
- Editable manual source: `manuals/tools/` (QMD; generated PDF/HTML are not editable).
- Module inventory: `manuals/tools/manifests/module-inventory.json`

## Conformance

- Vendored Fleet Agent API conformance template: `config/fleet_agent_api_conformance/v1/template.json`
- CI runner: `python scripts/run_agent_api_conformance.py`
